Screen 2. Finish is quiet, Save set is dominant. Mobile tap areas remain comfortable.
Screen 4. Finished first workout. Small green confirmation with title "Workout saved". Compose the result typographically on an open page: "Bench Press", dominant "135 lb × 5", and a single aligned fact row "1 set · 1 exercise · 675 lb volume". No metric grid or arbitrary trophies.
